description: A warm, serene living room with a soft California-casual aesthetic. On the table, two coffee-table books are stacked, and a round beige ceramic jug vase holds a casual arrangement of eucalyptus and leafy stems. A small ceramic bowl sits nearby. A second matching throw drapes over the far end of the sectional. The ceiling is smooth white plaster. Warm diffused ambient glow emanates from the central overhead source, adding a honeyed warmth to the otherwise cool-neutral palette.
